name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 6
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.6
source:
After meeting Tia in Krusniev, Akira's childhood friend Sanae meets up with Akira for team training. Akira consents, and when Meru and Tia hear about this they join him too.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE140886.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在克鲁斯涅夫遇见蒂亚后，阿基拉的儿时好友早苗与阿基拉一起参加团队训练。阿基拉同意了，梅鲁和蒂亚听说此事后也加入了他。
